```{python, results = "asis"}
import pickle
patNum = "pat001"
pklPath = "K:/iowaExpTest/rigidMovement/moveSummaryData/" + patNum + "/mainResults.pkl"
with open(pklPath, "rb") as f:
    res = pickle.load(f)
medTab = (
  res["medianTable"].
  rename(
    columns = {
      "toothNum": "Tooth Number",
      "medX": "X Median",
      "medY": "Y Median",
      "medZ": "Z Median",
      "medL2": "Length Median"
    }
  ).
  style.
  format(
    precision=3
  ).
  hide(axis="index").
  to_latex(
    hrules=True,
    caption="Median Directional Movements"
  )
)
print(patNum)
print(medTab)
print("earlyTest")

```


```{python}
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_histogram
import pandas as pd
dat = pd.DataFrame({
    "x": [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 7]
})

p = (
    ggplot(dat, aes(x="x"))
    + geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="dodgerblue", color="black")
)

p
```
